pack_status: frozen-snapshot (pre-release; formal v0.4.0 release gate pending)
purpose: Immutable evidence pack for the P0/P1 audit fixes (2026-08-25). The historical artifacts/v0.1.0 directory was appended to after its release — documented in this manifest and in docs/audits/ — and is now frozen as-is; this pack is the frozen snapshot of ALL current evidence. New experiments must go to a new pack/version.

hardware.server: autodl2 (shared with agent-ttrl; GPU-priority rules per CLAUDE.md)

dataset: Frozen countdown/GSM8K-style manifests in examples/countdown (8 training prompts, 8 disjoint frozen held-out prompts)
checksums: SHA256SUMS (regenerated at freeze; sha256sum -c must pass)

runs.rl_training: 19-step legacy bounded off-policy run, recovered from events; in-train curve with collapse (success 0.28->0.78->0.09), weight delta 10.4 fp32
runs.rl_training_final: 20-step P0-fixed run, 3x interruption/resume, step 4-20 + full_curve.json, final weight delta 9.53
runs.batch_online_512: 512 real rollouts x 8 injected faults = 4096 decisions (main snapshot evidence)
runs.batch_online_256: 256 real rollouts x 8 injected faults = 2048 decisions
runs.sync_noop: stale-runtime detection (server v0 vs trainer v20, drift 7 -> STALE RUNTIME DETECTED)
runs.guarded_trainer: P1-1 official GuardedGRPOTrainer 1-step server-mode smoke (4 rollouts + commit sha)
runs.heldout: frozen 8-prompt held-out probe: base v0 25% vs trained v10 25% (no generalization - honest negative)
runs.replay: 24 paired gradient probes (F2 0.93 / F3 0.53 / F4 0.19 mean cosine)

honest_notes: 256/512-rollout fault decisions are TARGETED deterministic injections of F1-F8 over real rollouts - NOT natural online incidents
Gradient probes use v1 weights + documented deterministic drift (seed=7, sigma=0.005) - mechanism probes, not natural incidents
Canary is a greedy behavior sketch, not byte-level attestation
No malicious-producer resistance claimed; targets silent wiring errors in dev environments
run_manifest.json in this pack carries the real provenance; the historical v0.1.0/run_manifest.json was a Windows-shell placeholder (documented gap, now fixed)
verify_command: cd artifacts/v0.4.0 && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS && cd ../.. && uv run grpo-guard verify --artifact-dir artifacts/v0.4.0 --events artifacts/v0.4.0/loop/events/events
